rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for money, including wealth in ordinary speech.

example.english: I don't have enough money to buy this phone.
example.traditional: 我冇咁多錢買呢部電話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 gam3 do1 cin2 maai5 ni1 bou6 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean banknotes and coins rather than cards, credit, or cheques.

example.english: This place only accepts cash money, not cards.
example.traditional: 呢度淨係收現金，唔收卡。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 zing6 hai6 sau1 jin6 gam1 m4 sau1 kaat1

rows.note: Use this for a wealthy person or, by extension, wealthy people as a group.

example.english: She married a man with money.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaa3 zo2 go3 jau5 cin2 jan4

rows.note: Use this formal term for wealth as an abstract possession or accumulated assets.

example.jyutping: coi4 fu3 m4 hai6 jan4 sang1 ge3 cyun4 bou6
